changeSet.author: lexavault
changeSet.sql:
create or replace function reporting_capture_package_dimensions( p_tenant uuid, p_package uuid, p_business_record uuid ) returns void language plpgsql as $$ begin if p_business_record is null or not exists ( select 1 from reporting_dimension_definitions where tenant_id=p_tenant and enabled_flag=true) then return; end if; insert into reporting_package_dimensions ( tenant_id, package_id, dimension_key, dimension_label, dimension_value, captured_at ) select p_tenant, p_package, rd.dimension_key, rd.dimension_label, v.display_value, now() from reporting_dimension_definitions rd join fld_record r on r.entity_uuid=rd.tenant_id and r.product_code='LEXAVAULT' and r.record_type='business-record' and r.record_id=p_business_record::text join fld_value v on v.record_uuid=r.record_uuid and lower(v.field_key)=lower(rd.dimension_key) and v.position=0 and not v.sensitive where rd.tenant_id=p_tenant and rd.enabled_flag=true on conflict (tenant_id, package_id, dimension_key) do update set dimension_label=excluded.dimension_label, dimension_value=excluded.dimension_value; end $$;
create or replace function reporting_backfill_tenant_dimensions(p_tenant uuid) returns integer language plpgsql as $$ declare affected integer; begin insert into reporting_package_dimensions ( tenant_id, package_id, dimension_key, dimension_label, dimension_value, captured_at ) select f.tenant_id, f.package_id, rd.dimension_key, rd.dimension_label, v.display_value, now() from reporting_package_facts f join reporting_dimension_definitions rd on rd.tenant_id=f.tenant_id and rd.enabled_flag=true join fld_record r on r.entity_uuid=f.tenant_id and r.product_code='LEXAVAULT' and r.record_type='business-record' and r.record_id=f.business_record_id::text join fld_value v on v.record_uuid=r.record_uuid and lower(v.field_key)=lower(rd.dimension_key) and v.position=0 and not v.sensitive where f.tenant_id=p_tenant and f.business_record_id is not null on conflict (tenant_id, package_id, dimension_key) do update set dimension_label=excluded.dimension_label, dimension_value=excluded.dimension_value; get diagnostics affected = row_count; return affected; end $$;
